description: This file provides helper functions and classes for generating signed X.509v3 certificates using OpenSSL commands. It manages certificate creation, key generation, configuration, and certificate chain writing, primarily for testing or development purposes.

classes.name: Key
classes.description: Represents a public/private key pair stored on disk.

classes.name: Certificate
classes.description: Helps in building, configuring, and finalizing an X.509 certificate, including key management, CSR creation, and signing.

methods.name: set_default_validity_range
methods.description: Sets the default start and end dates for certificate validity periods.

methods.name: get_unique_path_id
methods.description: Generates a unique filename component based on a given name.

methods.name: get_path_in_tmp_dir
methods.description: Constructs a path within the temporary output directory.

methods.name: create_self_signed_root_certificate
methods.description: Creates a self-signed root CA certificate.

methods.name: create_intermediate_certificate
methods.description: Creates an intermediate CA certificate signed by an issuer.

methods.name: create_end_entity_certificate
methods.description: Creates an end-entity certificate signed by an issuer.
